message:
The other day, I found myself staring at the weather forecast that promised a winter storm of epic proportions. I thought, "What do I have on hand?" The answer, it turns out, was a half-eaten bag of marshmallows and a collection of expired coupons. 

In a moment of panic, I realized that my emergency prep plan had turned into a snack plan. So, I bundled up and braved the snow to stock up on a few essentials. 

Who knew that preparing for a storm could feel like an unexpected adventure? Turns out, laughter is part of the prep too! 

What’s your go-to tip for being ready when Mother Nature decides to throw a tantrum?
